.ends bias_reference_mirror
children.role_hint: Diode-connected PMOS current reference generating gate bias node iref_snk
children.role_description: Diode-connected PMOS that converts the external sink current iref_snk into a gate-bias voltage, forming the master leg of a PMOS current mirror that sets tail/load currents throughout the LDO.

children.netlist:
.subckt error_amplifier_input_stage gnd vdd vin fb iref_snk net7 net6
M4 net7 vin net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M3 net6 fb net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M2 net5 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
M8 net6 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M7 net7 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
.ends error_amplifier_input_stage
children.role_hint: Differential input error amplifier stage with PMOS pair and NMOS mirror load
children.role_description: First-stage differential transconductance amplifier using a PMOS input pair (M3/M4) with a common current-source tail (M2) and an NMOS current-mirror load (M7/M8), converting the Vin–fb error into a single-ended voltage at net7.

children.netlist:
.subckt second_gain_stage gnd vdd iref_snk net7 net2
M6 gnd net7 net2 vdd pmos l=l_eab_p w=w_eab_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M5 net2 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
.ends second_gain_stage
children.role_hint: Second gain stage driving pass device gate, with current source load
children.role_description: Common-source second gain stage (M6) loaded by a PMOS current source (M5) that amplifies the first-stage output net7 and produces the high-impedance drive node net2 for the pass transistor gate.

children.netlist:
.subckt "Error Amplifier Chain" gnd vdd fb iref_snk net2 net7 vin
M4 net7 vin net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M3 net6 fb net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M2 net5 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
M8 net6 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M7 net7 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M6 gnd net7 net2 vdd pmos l=l_eab_p w=w_eab_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n

.ends "Error Amplifier Chain"
children.role_description: Two-stage error amplifier that senses the difference between Vin and the feedback voltage fb and produces a high-gain control signal to drive the pass device gate, providing the loop gain needed for accurate regulation.

children.netlist:
.subckt pass_device_output_feedback gnd vdd net2 vo fb
M0 vo net2 vdd vdd pmos l=l_power_p w=w_power_p*1 m=1 nf=1
R1 vo fb res r1
R2 fb gnd res r2
CL vo GND cap cload
.ends pass_device_output_feedback
children.role_hint: PMOS pass device, feedback resistor divider, and load capacitor
children.role_description: Large PMOS pass transistor (M0) acting as the series regulating element, with an output resistive divider (R1/R2) generating the feedback voltage fb and a load capacitor (CL) for output stabilization and transient response.

children.netlist:
.subckt miller_compensation net7 vo
R0 net1 vo res r0
C0 net7 net1 cap c0
.ends miller_compensation
children.role_hint: Miller compensation RC network between output and first-stage node for stability
children.role_description: Series RC (R0/C0) Miller compensation network bridging the output Vo and the first-stage node net7 to introduce pole-splitting and a stabilizing zero, ensuring loop phase margin across load conditions.

.ends "LDO Regulation Loop"
children.role_description: Core feedback regulation loop comprising the error amplifier chain, PMOS pass device with resistive feedback divider, and Miller compensation, which together regulate Vo by comparing the divided output against the reference input Vin.
